title: Choose the visual world for Roblox MCP Command Deck
question: The roll assigned Tactical Avionics & Logic Analyzer Deck. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Tactical Avionics & Logic Analyzer Deck
options.lineage: Aerospace avionics MFDs & hardware logic analyzers
options.thesis: Dense instrumentation console fusing low-level machine registers with high-precision aerospace telemetry.
options.viewport: Top KPI status HUD with phosphor indicators, split-pane instance telemetry, collapsible tool explorer with live hex/JSON debugger.
options.risk: Can feel overly intimidating if typography and hierarchy lack breathing room.

raised.raise: Tools and endpoints cataloged with sequential technical index codes and categorical industrial accents.
Ultra-crisp monospace tabular columns with instant high-contrast negative flash on state changes.

options.label: Rackmount Telemetry Cockpit
options.lineage: Modular server racks & memory profiling workbenches
options.thesis: High-density dark modular rack with dedicated telemetry meters and instant status indicators.
options.viewport: Floating control bar, live process memory monitor, and dual-column tool inspector.
options.risk: Familiar to developers; risks resembling standard developer tooling if not sharply executed.

options.label: Datamatics Monochrome Sublime
options.lineage: Ryoji Ikeda datamatics & binary data streams
options.thesis: Pure high-contrast black-and-white data sublime where barcode line densities structure the entire system.
options.viewport: Relentless monospace data grid, streaming byte tickers, zero color distraction.
options.case: Exceptional visual discipline and uncompromising density; slightly diminishes quick visual category triage.
options.risk: Extreme starkness may fatigue eyes during prolonged debugging sessions.

options.label: Saville Factory Records Catalog
options.lineage: Peter Saville Factory Records sleeve systems
options.case: Strong conceptual aesthetic, but cryptic color codes obscure fast parameter entry and real-time execution.
options.kept: Sequential artifact numbering and clean categorical color blocks for tools.

canonCard.label: The Category Standard
canonCard.thesis: Clean modern developer dashboard with dark slate surfaces, blue accents, and standard card grids.
canonCard.viewport: Horizontal topbar, KPI cards row, instances grid, search input, and execution panel.
canonCard.risk: Safe and functional, but visually generic and indistinguishable from standard SaaS templates.
